title: HIM 102 - Medical Record Science and Clinical Coding

items.q: Clinical coding may be defined as
o: a court order requiring a witness to attend and bring named records
the officer who abstracts, files and traces entries in a registry
the translation of written diagnoses and procedures into standard code numbers
the chosen method by which folders are arranged and returned to the shelves
items.s: Clinical coding: the translation of written diagnoses and procedures into standard code numbers. The other options describe Registry clerk, Subpoena, Filing system.

items.q: Which term is described by “the officer who abstracts, files and traces entries in a registry”?
o: Follow-up
Registry clerk
Case finding
Registry

items.s: Follow-up: the tracing of registered patients to learn how their condition progressed. The other options describe Retention period, Soundex, Legibility.
